description: This file defines the EmpPictureDecorator class, which provides additional behavior (decorator pattern) around the EmpPicture entity, including methods to set employee references and retrieve picture data as a string.

classes.name: EmpPictureDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for EmpPicture entity providing methods to manage employee pictures, including retrieving and setting employee references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmpPicture instance.

methods.name: getEmpPicture
methods.description: Protected method to access the wrapped EmpPicture entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee reference in EmpPicture based on employee number.

methods.name: getPicture
methods.description: Retrieves the picture data as a string, converting resource streams if necessary.
